acceptance: A pre-planted read-only failure-dossier.json that claims a system class (build_declared infrastructure-systemic) does not defer the item; the build's class counts only from orchestrator memory (the ledger and the build report) for the current cycle (red first: the planted file deferred the item as pipeline-repair)

A failure-decision.json that exists before the retro dispatch is removed by the host, so only this cycle's retro can write one; when the host cannot remove it, the cycle marks the decision untrusted and neither the defer rule nor the retro floor reads it (fail closed)
The FAIL closeout routes the defer that ended the cycle from a value carried on the cycle result and reads no workspace file
fix: Take the defer inputs from orchestrator memory for the current cycle: the build's corroborated class from failureDossier (never the dossier file), a failure-decision.json that the host cleared before the retro (untrusted when the clear fails), and the resolved defer carried on CycleResult (DeferCategory, DeferFixType) for the closeout.
source: independent review of #1083, 2026-10-21: a forged dossier defers an item
summary: After #1083, deferDecisionIn read build_declared back from failure-dossier.json in the cycle workspace, and the closeout read failure-decision.json from the workspace. Any agent that can write the workspace can create a read-only failure-dossier.json that claims a system class, so the host write fails silently (the write error was dropped) and the planted claim defers the item. failure-decision.json (#1078) had the same weakness: a file planted before the retro survived as the retro's decision.
title: A planted read-only failure-dossier.json or failure-decision.json decides the defer of an item

consumed.resolution: fix/defer-inputs-from-host-memory (stacked on #1083): deferDecision takes the build's class from failureDossier in memory; clearRetroDecisionInput removes failure-decision.json before each retro, on the live and the resume path, and sets CycleState.FailureDecisionUntrusted when it cannot; trustedFailureDecision gates the defer rule and the retro floor; carryDefer puts the defer on CycleResult on both paths (a WARN when a defer reason resolves no defer) and cycleoutcome routes core.DeferOf(result). The dossier is written through atomicwrite (a planted symlink is replaced, never followed); a failed write is a WARN. A planted audit-report.md before audit round 0 is filed as planted-audit-report-before-the-first-audit. ADR-0072 D4. The review's LOW (recoveryguard and gatesOnIntactTree drop the first snapshot error on retake) is not in this change: it needs RetakenAfter from #1082.
